items.title_zh: “睡眠，实现财务自由”：丁克（双收入，无孩子）夫妇的生活是这样的
items.title_en: ‘Sleep, Travel To Financial Freedom’: Here’s How Life Looks Like For DINK (Double Income, No Kids) Couples
items.summary_zh: 丁克（“Double Income, No Kids”）的缩写形式，当夫妻们开始炫耀他们的旅行、疯狂购物、节日和无孩子生活的所有福利时，丁克又卷土重来。
items.summary_en: DINK—short form of "Double Income, No Kids", made a comeback when couples started flaunting their trips, shopping sprees, festivals and all the perks of living child-free.

items.title_zh: “Dogesh Bhai”在大胆的 Vande Bharat 火车特技中险些丧命：“Khatron Ke Khiladi” |视频
items.title_en: ‘Dogesh Bhai’ Narrowly Escapes Death In Daring Vande Bharat Train Stunt: ‘Khatron Ke Khiladi’ | Video
items.summary_zh: 视频在一个火车站台上开始，可以看到这只狗悠闲地漫步，仿佛这个地方是他的。
items.summary_en: The video opens on a railway platform where the dog is seen casually strolling around as if he owns the place.

items.title_zh: 女子用滑板车撞车后说“IPS Ki Maa Hu”：“阿姨只是想弯曲”
items.title_en: Woman Says ‘IPS Ki Maa Hu’ After Hitting Car With Her Scooty: ‘Aunty Just Wanted To Flex’
items.summary_zh: 这名女子骑着踏板车，不小心划伤了一辆汽车，但当男子与她对峙并要求赔偿损坏时，她愤怒地反应。
items.summary_en: The woman, riding a scooter, accidentally scratched a car, but when the man confronted her and asked to pay for the damage, she reacted angrily.
